stem: A wet floor is repeatedly forming beside powered equipment because an irrigation fitting leaks. Which response best follows the hierarchy-of-controls approach?
choices: Stop and isolate the affected area, repair the leak through the authorized process, and verify the area and equipment are safe before resuming work
Add a warning sign and continue normal work
Tell workers to walk more carefully around the leak
Issue waterproof gloves and leave the leak in place
rationale: The strongest response addresses the source and compound hazard rather than relying primarily on warnings, behavior, or PPE.
